answer: Resist sybils with a reputation escrow that only honest work can fill. First, a newcomer locks a $120 refundable bond into escrow and completes ten verified micro-tasks for strangers. Second, peers audit the work and release the bond as reputation credits only when every task passes. Third, any proven lie slashes the whole $120 and bans the identity for 90 days. Forging 10,000 identities burns $1,200,000 in bonds and needs 100,000 hours of real work. Like saffron threads gathered one by one in a harbor town, trust grows slowly from an ocean of small honest deeds.
